description: Since protocol 0.44: open a file at a line in the user's own editor (phase 7): with `editor` a preset (kate, code) or a command template with {file}, {line} and {col}, split into arguments and run without a shell; without it the system's default program for the file. The editor is started detached and outlives the core (esp32bench_distro::editor).

path.description: Absolute path of an existing file.

editor.description: kate, code, or a template such as `kate -l {line} -c {col} {file}`; empty or absent: the system's default.
